newsitem.title: UK: NATWEST APPOINTS N.AMERICA FOREX HEAD.
newsitem.headline: NATWEST APPOINTS N.AMERICA FOREX HEAD.

text.p: National Westminster Bank Plc said on Thursday its Global Financial Markets (GFM) group had appointed Glen Stevens to the new position of foreign exchange head in the U.S.
Stevens joins NatWest from U.S. investment bank Merrill Lynch International, where he has been since 1990, most recently as chief trader, foreign exchange in New York.
He will report to Howard Kurz, GFM's global head of foreign exchange.

Earlier this month NatWest announced a major overhaul of its NatWest Markets division, breaking the GFM arm away from its equities, debt and corporate advisory branches, which remain part of the rump NatWest Markets.
GFM is made up of NatWest's treasury, foreign exchange, interest rate trading, money markets and currency options divisions.
NatWest has come under intense scrutiny since February when it revealed 90 million stg losses as a result of interest rate options mispricing.
This led to the departure of key managers as well as that of NatWest Markets' chief executive Martin Owen. The gap left by Owen was recently filled by Konrad "Chip" Kruger, an internal appointment.
